rule: A name is 1 to 100 characters, with no control characters.

accepted.covers: spaces and a tab around and inside, made one space
accepted.name: Kana Fan

accepted.covers: a decomposed accent, kept in NFC
accepted.name: José

accepted.covers: a byte order mark before it, which is trimmed as JavaScript trims
accepted.name: Kana

accepted.covers: a byte order mark after it, trimmed too
accepted.name: Kana

accepted.covers: a no-break space inside, made a space
accepted.name: Kana Fan

accepted.covers: a line separator inside, made a space
accepted.name: Kana Fan

accepted.covers: a hundred spaces inside, made one
accepted.name: Kana Fan

accepted.covers: a combining mark on a space, which stays and counts
accepted.name: Kana ́Fan

accepted.covers: an emoji with a variation selector
accepted.name: ❤️ Kana

accepted.covers: a kanji outside the basic plane
accepted.name: 𠮷野

accepted.covers: a hundred emoji, counted as characters, not UTF-16 units
a hundred letters with spaces around them, counted once trimmed
a hundred decomposed accents, counted once in NFC

refused.covers: a byte order mark inside, an invisible format character
a zero-width space before it, which is not trimmed
a next-line control, which JavaScript does not trim
an emoji joined by a zero-width joiner
ninety-nine letters and a space carrying a combining mark: 101 characters
